reason: Paused and recovered cost payments: PendingCostMoveResume::CounterAdditionUnlessPayment gains unpaid_suffix (UnpaidCostSuffix: its payer and the remainder still owed, either the unpaid legs of a paused unless effect-cost or the count of a repeated draw cost's remaining instructions), WaitingFor::UnlessPayment and the mana-ability resume gain repeat (the compact age-counter count of a cumulative-upkeep draw cost; the same prompt, equal to the one derived from the parked payment, is also the continuation of a repeated draw payment whose work slice ended, where repeat is the instructions still owed and declining is refused), PendingContinuation gains head_payment_origin (a queued PayCost remainder resumes a payment already chosen), PendingCast gains activation_cost_paused_on_draw, ResolutionPaymentTransaction gains recovered (the accepted prefix and cursor of a staged payment kept across another player's concession; its state is written and read in the persisted raw form, through the saved-game ingress), and DerivedViews gains unless_draw_cost (the resolved draw count and repetition the client renders, and the stage that tells it whether a repeated payment already begun can still be declined). An older peer drops these keys, settling a paused or repeated cost with legs unpaid, paying one draw for many, re-gating a latched remainder as a fresh choice, or replaying a staged payment's accepted prefix from the base. PendingReplacement gains ordering_peers (the candidates passed over when an optional candidate's turn to apply is selected from an ordering among several, so that prompt is not taken for one that leaves out an effect which began to apply while it was parked; a record without the key is re-proposed once when it is answered beside another applicable effect). PendingCostMoveResume also gains ReplacementMayCostInnerChoice (an accepted entry MayCost parked while its leg's own replacement choice is answered), which an older peer cannot decode.
